title: Donation Recovery Symptom Log Freshness
dataSources: Volunteer shifts (`community:shift`), donations (`community:donation`), mutual-aid requests (`community:mutualaid`), service ops (`community:impact`).
app: Community-service telemetry — food-bank shift logs, blood-donation records, and mutual-aid request maps — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=community:donation donation_type=* donation_epoch=* symptom_logged_epoch=*
| eval lag_hours=round((symptom_logged_epoch-donation_epoch)/3600,1)
| stats avg(lag_hours) as avg_lag_hours, max(lag_hours) as worst_lag_hours by donation_type
| sort - avg_lag_hours
description: Measures recovery-log lag by donation type for donation recovery notes.
value: Lag tracking shows which donation type create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside donation recovery notes.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `recovery-log lag` on `community:donation` events and aggregate them by `donation_type`.
visualization: Table of donation type with average and worst recovery-log lag.
grandmaExplanation: It totals how long things take for each donation type so you can see where donation recovery notes slows down.
